messages:
maria: Hey, seeing quicklinks show items from the previous workspace for a second after I switch. Screenshot: https://img.internal/quicklink-flash.png

sam: Can you repro? steps?

maria: Yep repro steps: 1) switch workspace via top-left selector, 2) open quicklinks (top-right card), 3) see items from old workspace for ~1-2s then it corrects. ~1/20 switches.

andrew: Sounds like cache TTL + key mismatch. Did we roll out a new quicklinks cache recently?

jules: We did last week — moved quicklinks to edge Redis and consolidated keys to `org:{org_id}:quicklinks` to improve hit rate. We left out workspace scope to reduce cardinality.

olivia: Oof. Org-scoped key would explain cross-workspace flashes for users who are in multiple workspaces under the same org. Any telemetry?

jules: Telemetry shows `console.quicklink.cache_hit` +12% after rollout. Also we have a small spike `console.quicklink.cross_workspace_exposure` ~0.4% starting at the deploy time. I set an alert but it was low severity.

sam: We should fix quickly. Options: revert rollout (latency/UX regression) or change key to include workspace_id. Revert is blunt but fast. Patch is safer.

andrew: Fastest path: patch cache key at the gateway to include `X-Workspace-ID`. But the console client currently doesn't send that header for the quicklinks call — it reads workspace from JS state. So either change client or change API to accept a query param.

maria: I can add the header in the client in ~30m. Concern: older browser cached bundles won't send it immediately.

olivia: Server-side safe default needed. Short term we should invalidate the org-scoped key so users don't get leaked items until clients are updated. Long term change key to include workspace.

jules: OK I'll open a PR to invalidate `org:{org_id}:quicklinks` keys and switch to `org:{org_id}:workspace:{ws_id}:quicklinks`. Also adding a canary rollout + kill switch.

andrew: Add an integration test that simulates a user with access to two workspaces switching rapidly. Also update rollout docs to mention the cardinality tradeoff.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for console-quicklinks v2 -> pods 2/3.

sam: Owners: jules (cache invalidation + backend key change), maria (client header fallback), andrew (integration test + rollout doc). Please post PRs and ETA.

jules: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1789 — changes key format + invalidation script. Requesting review. ETA ~3h for review and 5h to prod rollout. :shipit:

maria: I'll open client PR now to send `X-Workspace-ID` on quicklink fetches with a fallback to query param for old clients.

olivia: Also create a short CS note in case customers ask. Low impact but we should be transparent.

sam: @kate can you draft a one-liner for CS and standby for Qs? Also add a telemetry metric `console.quicklink.perceived_cross_workspace` for the postmortem.

kate: On it, drafting now and will post in #customer-success.

andrew: After fix, let's run a week of canary traffic and monitor `console.quicklink.cross_workspace_exposure` and perceived metrics before we widen.

jules: Agreed. I'll add the metrics and the rollout flag.

maria: Thanks team — will send PR links here once up.
